overview.headlineHtml: A detached villa on the golf front line
copy: El Campanario Golf Villa is a single detached house on the golf front line at El Campanario, Estepona, arranged over a semi-basement, ground floor and first floor with a private pool and garden.

The ground floor holds an open living and dining room of 37.90 sqm with a separate 23.60 sqm dining area and a 16.00 sqm kitchen, opening to a 28.06 sqm covered porch, a 31.75 sqm solarium and the pool. Two bedrooms sit on the first floor and two more in the semi-basement, alongside a 24.30 sqm media room and a 14.34 sqm games room. Planning permission has been granted and the developer gives delivery as Q4 2026 to Q1 2027.
